owner_scope: Existing BlockHorizon research owner, #1157 scientific adjudication, #1512 Research Lab. Owner-present interactive 2026-11-20 explicitly authorized bounded private historical research. Relay is evidence only, not native human GitHub approval or exact-head merge consent.

scope.primary_question: Marginal information from cohort-relative realized spending stress beyond price and aggregate on-chain model

preconditions: Independent exact-head review and existing original research/source/science gates.
Native owner-gated merge; exact contract readback on main. Branch/comment alone is not permission.

Freeze private source run header (exact source hashes, price close convention/date alignment, cohort definition, cutoff and unresolved limitations) before outcome-linked access. Abort on source identity/units/definition failure.
Keep primary endpoint, baseline, stop/falsifier fixed before outcome. Private design digest is binding; reviewed corrections only before run. No retuning.
All restricted raw/normalized values and detailed results stay private. No standing change to existing prep or Round 3 authority.

Private immutable copy of public price bytes with the bound SHA256 reachable from private main before run; no substitute. Require strict year/day-axis schema, zero nulls, exact metadata and hashes before parsing, and fixed +1 clock check.

Before opening outcome-linked values append one unique private intent receipt identifying the exact merged release and readiness blobs, input/runner/decision hashes, clock and cutoff. Existing Research Lab owner checks for earlier intent/result; if any exists stop (no automatic retry).
completion: Run exact approved design once; privately retain inputs, output hash, paired losses, regime diagnostics, failures and negative results.
Independent adjudication; no new production signal. No repeat without separate admission.
If blocked, record exact gate and original owner, no bypass.

Append exact result receipt privately with intent ID, SHA256 of canonical LF-free JSON.stringify(rec), rejected anchors, per-model losses, decision, failures, explicit retrospective hindsight/SEMANTICS_OR_REVISION_STATE_UNVERIFIED label. Public completion pointer only receipt ID/hash, no market-derived values.

bound_run_inputs.hash_canonicalization: raw ASCII bytes unchanged, exact byte length and SHA256; JS exact LF ASCII code inside fences excluding trailing newline; no trim on raw

private_custody.activation: Require reviewed native squash merge and separate immutable receipt binding exact retained path/blob/hash at actual merge commit reachable from private main. Premerge branch commit is NOT main ancestry. Historical private_research placement is outside Round3 capture scan.

bound_run_inputs.clock_rule: CM_NATIVE_LABEL = MIRROR_LABEL - 1D; CLOSE_UTC = NATIVE_LABEL + 1D; BH_LABELS_UNCHANGED; SIGNAL_LAG_DAYS = 7
bound_run_inputs.clock_check: unique minimum median absolute log price reference difference at mirror offset +1, strictly below 0.005; no outcome access before pass

decision_rule.uncertainty: descriptive 90% circular moving-block bootstrap interval; block=3 anchors; B=2000; seed=20261120; lower must exceed zero for KEEP_FOR_RESEARCH

negative_controls.NC1: relative feature at 37-day lag, same models and anchors
negative_controls.NC2: 39 deterministic training-only block permutations of candidate feature, block length 3, seeds 20261120+j*1009+training_n; unchanged held-out features; candidate must exceed empirical 95th percentile of mean improvements
negative_controls.NC3: duplicate feature ID dedup; exact prediction equality required
negative_controls.NC4: last mature outcome and training calendar-month mean (fallback historical mean if fewer than 3); candidate must beat persistence, calendar, historical and price

mapping: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE if count below either fixed minimum
REJECT if pooled mean <= 0 or any negative control failure
REGIME_SPECIFIC if harm in either segment
decision_rule.deferred_gates: Calendar split is diagnostic, not a verified ETF-owner boundary; leave-one-cycle-out and ETF-era gate not complete; no forward-test eligibility in this one-shot scope. No waiver of the canonical blueprint; any later promotion must meet it separately.
